chunks: And in the narration of Yūnus ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from a man among our companions, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام,
that he was asked about bridges: are their owners liable for anything? He said: “No.”

key_terms.أَهْلُهَا: their owners or those responsible for them
key_terms.أَيَضْمَنُ: is liable or responsible for compensation

ai.seo_question: Are the owners of bridges liable if someone is harmed in connection with them?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that the owners or maintainers of bridges are not held liable in this case. It appears in a fiqh context dealing with responsibility for harm arising from structures or excavations, and indicates the absence of financial liability here.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5342 - In the narration of Yunus ibn Abd Al-Rahman from one of our companions, from Abu Abdullah (as),
he was asked about bridges and whether their owners are liable for anything. Imam (as) replied: "No."
